title: Outbroke
html:
Quest Giver: Junior Exec Ivan

Quest Type: Kill

Quest Description: Kill 20 Poison Mutant Unipsychos, 20 Poison Mutant Pukers, and 24 Poison Mutant Pincers in Upper Frump's Misfortune and Return to Junior Exec Ivan in Frump's Interdungeonal Resort.

Quest Reward: Gold and 1 King's Coin

Return to: Junior Exec Ivan

Repeatable: Yes

Zone: Frump's Misfortune (quest)

In-game text

Recovered from the Dungeon Runners client files. The notes above are from the old wiki when they exist.

Journal: Kill 20 Poison Mutant Unipsychos, 20 Poison Mutant Pukers, and 24 Poison Mutant Pincers in Upper Frump's Misfortune and Return to Junior Exec Ivan in Frump's Interdungeonal Resort.

Offer:

Outbreaks don't quarantine themselves. There are more Poison Mutants than we can count, but that doesn't mean we have to sit back and watch our customer base shrink because they get hit with this Ick-E virus thingy.

Roam the main areas of Upper Frump's Misfortune and kill Poison Mutant Unipsychos, Pukers, and Pincers. This is a great chance to get The Frump to notice you. Come and talk to me, Junior Exec Ivan, when you have finished treating the outbreak.

Turn-in:

Things are looking good for you, Dungeon Runner, and The Frump noticed that there isn't as much Ick in the dungeon. It is only a matter of time until he cares enough to know who is responsible. Come back and talk to me when you want to get out there and get yourself noticed.

Objectives:

  • Slain Poison Mutant Unipsychos
  • Slain Poison Mutant Pukers
  • Slain Poison Mutant Pincers

Client level range: 28–35
